message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-10 13:10 IST to 2026-11-11 13:10 IST (2026-11-10 07:40 to 2026-11-11 07:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** DLL_software_component.txt only. Component aliases and duplicate versioned rows were normalized within this file. Products.txt and List_of_SIA_Completed.txt were not read or combined.

No newly reported vulnerability was confirmed as a direct match to a component named in the DLL inventory. The mandatory independent MongoDB ecosystem sweep identified 26 newly published MongoDB Server CVEs, including vendor-scored 9.5 and 9.1 issues. One new ASP.NET Core SignalR Redis issue is retained separately as a possible match needing deployment review.

**Authoritative batch sources:** [MongoDB product alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts#security) and [MongoDB 9.0.7 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/9.0/#std-label-9.0.7---nov-10--2026).

### CVE-2026-118383 — MongoDB Server

- **Severity:** 9.5 (MongoDB vendor score)
- **Description:** A pre-authentication use-after-free in replica-set primary catch-up can affect MongoDB Server's replication component.
- **Affected product / relevance:** MongoDB Server 4.4 through 9.0 branches are affected below the vendor's fixed releases. Included by the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** MongoDB product alerts

### CVE-2026-120808 — MongoDB Server

- **Severity:** 9.1 (MongoDB vendor score)
- **Description:** The macOS TLS client may skip a certificate trust result for IPv6 connections, allowing certificate-validation bypass.
- **Affected product / relevance:** MongoDB Server 7.0 through 9.0 branches are affected below the vendor's fixed releases. Included by the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** MongoDB product alerts

### Possible match needing review — CVE-2026-114147

- **Product:** Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis / supported .NET 8–11 runtimes
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 7.5
- **Description:** Missing release of memory can let an unauthenticated network attacker cause denial of service.
- **Why review is needed:** The DLL inventory names StackExchange.Redis and Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Client, but not the affected ASP.NET Core SignalR Redis backplane package. Confirm whether Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis or an affected .NET runtime is deployed before treating this as applicable.
- **Source:** [Microsoft/GitHub advisory](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/security/advisories/GHSA-wr8v-9x5q-ggcm)

### MongoDB ecosystem coverage

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major maintained libraries and services, MongoDB-owned advisories, NVD/CVE records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible national CERT notices. The 26 MongoDB Server CVEs above were confirmed in-window; no additional fresh issue for the other MongoDB categories survived validation.

**Closing:** Immediate review is recommended for MongoDB deployments, especially CVE-2026-118383 and CVE-2026-120808. For the DLL inventory itself, no direct in-window component match was confirmed; validate the ASP.NET Core SignalR Redis backplane possibility against the actual dependency graph.
